meta.name: caveman-commit
meta.description: Write a Conventional Commits message compressed to intent only. Use for "write a commit", "commit message", /commit or /caveman-commit.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 浓缩代码改动为一句提交信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常为提交信息措辞犯难,希望留下清晰记录。
copy.tagline_en: Condense code changes into one commit message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often struggle with commit messages and want clean history.

howto.what: 收到写提交消息的请求后，它会生成一条只保留意图的简短 Conventional Commits 提交信息：主题行含类型和祈使句，正文只在需要说明原因、破坏性变更或关联 issue 时出现。以代码块输出，不会实际执行提交。
howto.when: 当你说“write a commit”、“commit message”、“/commit”等时触发。

say.text: 给我刚才的改动写条 commit message
say.note: 会生成只保留意图的简短消息

say.text: 用 Conventional Commits 格式给这个 diff 生成提交信息
say.note: 主题行按类型和祈使句生成

say.text: 把这次改动压缩成一句，并附上相关 issue
say.note: 涉及 issue 时会在末尾写 Closes #

howto.what_en: Claude writes terse Conventional Commits messages: subject line with type and imperative summary; body only when needed (why, breaking changes, migration, issues). Output as a code block. Does not run git commit, stage, or amend.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says "write a commit", "commit message", "/commit", etc.

say_en.text: Write a commit message for my changes just now
Generate a Conventional Commits message for this diff
say_en.note: Subject uses type with imperative mood

say_en.text: Compress this change into one line and link the issue
say_en.note: Adds Closes # at the end when relevant
